prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Works: It Predicts the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT generate answers by predicting one word at a time. Learn how training on huge amounts of text turns that simple trick into fluent conversation.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't think like you. It plays one game: guess the next word. Then it does it again, and again.

props.text: It just guesses the next word.

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: It learned by reading enormous amounts of text, adjusting itself each time it guessed wrong, until patterns of language became second nature.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: So every answer is built word by word from patterns. Fluent, but not always right. Treat it as a smart guesser.

props.text: Fluent is not the same as true.

beats.speaker: narrator
